title: Coordinate schema and verification engine with community-resource-maps to avoid forking
context: food-assistance-maps (Track 10) and community-resource-maps (Track 6) share significant overlap in schema, ingestion, verification, and freshness pipeline design. Running two separate implementations of the HSDS + provenance/freshness schema and the verification engine would waste effort and create drift. Per PLAN.md §12 and §Open questions, the two projects should coordinate to share a single schema/verification engine rather than fork. This task defines the coordination outcome and the shared package boundary.
objective: Coordinate with the community-resource-maps maintainers to assess the feasibility and shape of a shared schema + verification engine. Produce a design document that: (1) compares the two projects' schemas and verification requirements; (2) proposes a shared package boundary (e.g. a shared @elyos/hsds-core library) or a clear divergence decision with rationale; (3) identifies what must remain project-specific vs. what can be shared; and (4) records the agreed-upon outcome so both projects can proceed without silent forking.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema comparison documents the HSDS fields, provenance/freshness extensions, and any project-specific additions used by both food-assistance-maps and community-resource-maps

Design document proposes either: (a) a shared @elyos/hsds-core (or equivalent) package containing the shared schema, types, and validation; or (b) an explicit decision to keep separate implementations with a documented rationale
If a shared package is proposed, the package boundary is defined: what is shared (schema, types, ajv validator, staleness machine logic) vs. what is project-specific (adapters, domain fields)
Both project maintainers (or their representatives) have reviewed and agreed on the proposed coordination outcome
The agreed outcome is recorded in this project's ADR log and cross-referenced in community-resource-maps
No code is forked silently — if both projects proceed independently, the design document records this explicitly
output: docs/adr/adr-007-schema-coordination.md (coordination design document and outcome decision).
